title: BravesVision Top 10 2026
description:
Royals at Braves, March 27
Opening Night at Truist Park. Chris Sale scatters three hits over six scoreless innings before a sellout crowd, and Ozzie Albies, Drake Baldwin and Michael Harris II all go deep in a 6-0 win over Kansas City. Walt Weiss earns his first win.

title: Becoming a Brave
description: Behind-the-scenes of the 2026 Atlanta Braves draft class, from scouting to the draft, and their introduction into the franchise.

title: Riding with the Braves
description:
Walt Weiss
In this first episode, new manager Walt Weiss joins Braves Radio Network's Ben Ingram to talk about his career playing, coaching, and what his mindset is heading into the 2026 season.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
July 4
July 4: Down 7-3 entering the ninth, the Braves rally to force extras, then win it in the most unlikely way: with the bench empty, pitcher Max Fried steps in and lines a walk-off single to beat Miami 8-7 in 10 innings.

title: BravesVision Top 10 2026
description:
Phillies at Braves, April 26
Chris Sale wins the 150th game of his career, allowing one hit over six innings with nine strikeouts. Matt Olson's three-run homer off Aaron Nola opens the scoring as Atlanta beats Philadelphia 6-2 and becomes the first club to 20 wins.

title: Behind the Braves
description: Catcher and 2025 NL Rookie of the Year Drake Baldwin joins Ben Ingram in this episode of Riding with the Braves presented by Chevy!

title: Michael Harris II: The Dream and the Journey
description: This short film chronicles Michael Harris II's journey as a kid from Atlanta all the way to his big-league debut for his hometown team. Featuring conversations with Michael, his parents, high school coaches, mentors and scouts.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
August 6
August 6: The night the season turns. Atlanta climbs above .500 for the first time all year, riding a three-run rally sparked by a catcher's interference call and three RBIs from Adam Duvall to an 8-4 win over Washington.
